# ReelsGrab
> Free online video and audio downloader for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and Facebook Videos.

ReelsGrab is a high-speed, free web-based utility that enables users to download public videos and audio from Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube in high definition (1080p, 2K, 4K) and high-bitrate MP3 (up to 320kbps). No software installation, browser extensions, or account registration are required. All video processing happens in real time with zero watermarks.

## Core Downloader Tools
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/instagram-reels-download): Download public Instagram Reels in original MP4 HD quality without watermarks, including full synchronized audio and background music.
- [Facebook Reels Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/facebook-reels-download): Save Facebook Reels in 1080p Full HD with original sound stems directly to mobile or desktop.
- [Facebook Video Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/facebook-video-download): Download public Facebook videos, watch clips, and live recordings in 720p, 1080p, and 4K resolutions.
- [YouTube to MP3 Converter](https://www.reelsgrab.net/youtube-to-mp3): Extract high-fidelity audio up to 320kbps and 256kbps from YouTube videos and YouTube Shorts.
- [YouTube to MP4 Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/youtube-to-mp4): Download YouTube videos in Full HD 1080p, 2K, and 4K quality with crystal-clear audio.
- [Reels to MP3 Extractor](https://www.reelsgrab.net/reels-to-mp3): Extract background music and audio tracks from Instagram Reels and Facebook Reels as standalone MP3 files.
- [Bulk Reels Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/bulk-reels-downloader): Download multiple public Instagram Reels from a creator profile in a single batch session.
- [Private Facebook Video Downloader](https://www.reelsgrab.net/facebook-private-video-download): Step-by-step tool to download private Facebook group and personal videos you have authorized access to.
